## CORE RULE 6. Don't exploit the game, use cheats, or macros.
Bugs, Exploits, or unintended behavior utilized for strictly PVE scenarios (such as Salvage using lockers or crates to hide from ballistic turrets), generally does not apply for this rule. For all other issues outlined by the rule, and especially for any PVP scenarios (including partially player-controlled devices like the station AI or vault defense turrets), are not exempt. Both attempts and successful use are prohibited. The following is prohibited by this rule:
- Intentionally used bugs, exploits and unintended behaviors which gives the user an advantage over players who do not use them, even if their affects do not persist across rounds. - External tools and client modifications, including macros. - Anything non-intended which results in gaining elevated privileges, including admin tools. - Anything which prevents another player who is not game banned from being able to play on the servers, (not including in-character actions that do not persist across rounds.)
